rationale: Implements standard Particle Swarm Optimization with 10 particles, inertia weight 0.9, and cognitive/social coefficients 1.5. Uses seeded numpy RNG for reproducibility. Clips positions to [-5,5]^2. Tracks personal and global bests. Returns JSON-serializable dict with parameters, observations (all particles' best positions), and top 3 proposed improvements. Exactly budget evaluate calls are made.
